<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    a = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
    def bbox(col):
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(1,63) for c in range(0,63) if a[r][c]==col]
        if not pts: return None
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(pts))
    return bbox('B'), bbox('c'), bbox('Y')
for i in range(4):
    action(['UP'])
    print('after UP', i+1, ':', state())
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print('COMPLETED'); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
